directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints the figures for LZ 80 Diesel Concrete Pump. The row to open is /products/lz-80-diesel-concrete-pump. Yes, with output ≤ 95 m³/h. LZ-80 is 6800 kg and 256 kW. LZ-60 is 5500 kg and 145 kW. Both print 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m. Diesel 120’s 100 m³/h is not the low-pressure cell. Diesel 120 prints two 145 kW units and does not name Yuchai on the sheet used here. An LZ-80 purchase from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai is incomplete if it says only “95” or only “65”. The sheet prints Yuchai 256 kW, high pressure ≤ 65 m³/h and ≤ 35 MPa, low pressure ≤ 95 m³/h and ≤ 22 MPa, hopper 0.6 m³, conveying distance 120 m, aggregate 6 cm and below, outline 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m and 6800 kg. The section title “Dynamic Pressure Calculator - SI Units” comes from the source page and does not add a rating.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台印出的是LZ-80 的订单必须写明高压或低压的数字。要打开的行是 /products/lz-80-diesel-concrete-pump。6 cm 及以下。是，输送量 ≤ 95 m³/h。柴油120的 100 m³/h 不是低压格。LZ-80 是 6800 kg、256 kW。LZ-60 是 5500 kg、145 kW。两者都印 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m。柴油120印两台 145 kW，此处使用的表上没有写玉柴。向河北品锦机械（邢台）采购 LZ-80 时，如果只写“95”或只写“65”，订单是不完整的。该页印玉柴 256 kW，高压 ≤ 65 m³/h 和 ≤ 35 MPa，低压 ≤ 95 m³/h 和 ≤ 22 MPa，料斗 0.6 m³，输送距离 120 m，骨料 6 cm 及以下，外形 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m，6800 kg。节标题「动态 压力 计算器 - 国际单位制」来自来源页，不另加额定值。

heading.zh: 动态 压力 计算器 - 国际单位制

body.en: LZ 80 Diesel Concrete Pump is unchanged by the heading “Dynamic Pressure Calculator - SI Units”. Yes, with output ≤ 95 m³/h. Both print 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m. An LZ-80 purchase from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai is incomplete if it says only “95” or only “65”.
body.zh: LZ-80 的订单必须写明高压或低压不因标题「动态 压力 计算器 - 国际单位制」而改动。是，输送量 ≤ 95 m³/h。两者都印 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m。向河北品锦机械（邢台）采购 LZ-80 时，如果只写“95”或只写“65”，订单是不完整的。

heading.zh: 动态 压力 计算器 - 英制单位

body.en: This section is titled “Dynamic Pressure Calculator - Imperial Units”. LZ 80 Diesel Concrete Pump still prints the cells below. LZ-80 is 6800 kg and 256 kW. Diesel 120’s 100 m³/h is not the low-pressure cell. The sheet prints Yuchai 256 kW, high pressure ≤ 65 m³/h and ≤ 35 MPa, low pressure ≤ 95 m³/h and ≤ 22 MPa, hopper 0.6 m³, conveying distance 120 m, aggregate 6 cm and below, outline 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m and 6800 kg.
body.zh: 本节标题是「动态 压力 计算器 - 英制单位」。LZ-80 的订单必须写明高压或低压下面这些格子仍是印出来的。LZ-80 是 6800 kg、256 kW。柴油120的 100 m³/h 不是低压格。该页印玉柴 256 kW，高压 ≤ 65 m³/h 和 ≤ 35 MPa，低压 ≤ 95 m³/h 和 ≤ 22 MPa，料斗 0.6 m³，输送距离 120 m，骨料 6 cm 及以下，外形 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m，6800 kg。

question.en: Does “Dynamic Pressure Calculator - SI Units” replace Yes, with output ≤ 95 m³/h?
question.zh: 「动态 压力 计算器 - 国际单位制」会替换「6 cm 及以下。」吗？

answer.en: No. Yes, with output ≤ 95 m³/h remains the printed wording for LZ 80 Diesel Concrete Pump.
answer.zh: 不会。6 cm 及以下。仍是LZ-80 的订单必须写明高压或低压已印的说法。

question.en: Where does LZ-80 is 6800 kg and 256 kW belong on the LZ 80 Diesel Concrete Pump row?
question.zh: LZ-80 的订单必须写明高压或低压这一行里，「是，输送量 ≤ 95 m³/h。」放在哪里？

answer.en: It belongs on /products/lz-80-diesel-concrete-pump, beside the other printed cells, not under a guessed heading.
answer.zh: 它属于 /products/lz-80-diesel-concrete-pump，和其他已印格子在一起，不放到猜出来的标题下面。

question.en: What does “Dynamic Pressure Calculator - Imperial Units” add to LZ 80 Diesel Concrete Pump?
question.zh: 「动态 压力 计算器 - 英制单位」给LZ-80 的订单必须写明高压或低压增加了什么？

answer.en: It is only the section title taken from https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/dynamic-pressure-d_1037.html. It does not add a performance figure.
answer.zh: 它只是取自 https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/dynamic-pressure-d_1037.html 的节标题，不增加性能数字。
